svg.title: Ask the tutor: answers come from the course material, with links
svg.text: Ask the tutor: answers come from the course material, with links
Any question, any time. Answers come from the course material, or the web as a fallback, cited with links. Or the tutor says so.
Student
the chat panel in the shell
Server and orchestrator
server.py, retrieval.py
Tutor model
anthropic, claude_code, ollama, or mock
1 the question text, and the unit on screen
2 Retrieve, in code
retrieval.py: lexical search over the knowledge
base, top 3 chunks, source text ranked first;
plus the unit on screen and recent chat turns
3 qa.md: the chunks, each with its source and link,
and the earlier turns (context, not a source)
4 Search, on claude_code
Grep and Read the knowledge base, the
lessons, and the reference facts; never
the exam keys or progress. Then the web,
if the course does not answer.
5 a cited_answer block, streamed as written
6 the answer streams in, each source as a link
When the material does not answer
The model sets in_corpus to false and says the question is
not covered. It does not reason its way to a rule.
No match, no unit on screen, and no search: the server
says so itself, without a model call.
Web search, a fallback
On claude_code while supports_web_search is true;
on anthropic, off by default. FAA and government
sources come first, and a rule never comes from
another site. Answers from the web are labelled.
Earlier chat turns are context only, never a source.
